sources.title: Pd Api Point Intersection
sources.publisher: Planning Data / Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.verified_claim: Planning Data coordinate queries return entities whose geometry intersects the supplied WGS84 point.

sources.title: Pd Api Multi Dataset
sources.publisher: Planning Data / Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.verified_claim: The API accepts one or more dataset filters and returns intersecting entities from those datasets.

sources.title: Pd Api Absence Caveat
sources.publisher: Planning Data / Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.verified_claim: Planning Data explicitly warns that absence of results does not prove absence of constraints because coverage varies.

sources.title: Pd Api Portfolio Rate
sources.publisher: Planning Data / Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.verified_claim: The API has no batch endpoint; per-property requests should be rate-limited and bulk data used for large portfolios.

sources.title: Brownfield Total
sources.publisher: Planning Data / Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government

sources.title: Brownfield Providers
sources.publisher: Planning Data / Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.verified_claim: Brownfield land currently reports 354 data providers.

sources.title: Brownfield Auth
sources.publisher: Planning Data / Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.verified_claim: The brownfield-land dataset states that all data are from authoritative sources.

sources.title: Brownfield Status Gate
sources.publisher: Planning Data / Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.verified_claim: Brownfield records can carry planning-permission status/type and site-category context; parcel scoring still requires exact point/site match.

promotion_gate: Exact point intersection with a current brownfield-land entity is required before candidate brownfield context is promoted.
